================================================================================
Trino blocks: WITH FUNCTION with a body of BEGIN ... END
================================================================================

WITH FUNCTION answer()
  RETURNS bigint
  BEGIN
    DECLARE a bigint DEFAULT 6;
    DECLARE b bigint DEFAULT 7;
    RETURN a * b;
  END
SELECT answer();
SELECT 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Trino blocks: WITH FUNCTION with RETURN and no BEGIN
================================================================================

WITH FUNCTION f() RETURNS int RETURN 1 SELECT f();
SELECT 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Trino blocks: two routines with nested blocks after comments
================================================================================

/* the routines */
-- of the query
with function clamp(x int)
  returns int
  begin
    if x > 9 then
      return 9;
    end if;
    while x < 0 do
      set x = x + 1;
    end while;
    return case when x = 5 then 4 else x end;
  end,
function two()
  returns int
  return 2
select clamp(n), two() from t where begin = 1;
select 3;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Trino blocks: a WITH that FUNCTION does not follow
================================================================================

with q as (select 1 as begin) select begin from q;
select 2;

  (statement))

================================================================================
Trino blocks: WITH FUNCTION in the middle of a statement
================================================================================

select 1; insert into t with function f() returns int begin return 1; end select f();

================================================================================
Trino blocks: a variable right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create function f() returns int begin :decl; return :y; end;
with function g() returns int begin :'body'; end select g();
select 2;

================================================================================
Trino blocks: a character that is not in a word right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create function f() returns int begin (select 1); return 1; end;
with function g() returns int begin "x" = 1; begin 'y'; end; end select g();
select 2;
